strong.span: We believe in more sustainable technology.

p.span: RELOOP was founded in 2018 based on the belief that the best devices shouldn't end up in the trash after just two years. Since then, we have refurbished more than 50,000 devices and reduced thousands of metric tons of electronic waste.

p.span: Six concrete commitments that distinguish ordinary refurbishment from the RELOOP experience.

div.class: o_colored_level border o_grid_item rounded g-col-lg-4 g-height-5 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-check s_features_icon mb-3 bg-o-color-3 rounded text-o-color-1

p.span: Each device undergoes a series of 52 technical tests before receiving its rating: battery, screen, connectivity, sensors, nothing is left to chance.

div.class: border o_grid_item rounded o_colored_level g-height-5 g-col-lg-4 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-lock s_features_icon mb-3 rounded bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-1

p.span: Each device undergoes a DoD 5220.22-M certified data erasure. Zero residual data, zero risk for both the buyer and the reseller.

div.class: border o_grid_item rounded o_colored_level g-height-5 g-col-lg-4 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-clock-o s_features_icon mb-3 rounded bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-1

p.span: All our devices come with a 12-month warranty covering parts and labor. An extension up to 24 months is available. If the appliance breaks down, we'll take care of it.

div.class: border o_grid_item rounded o_colored_level g-col-lg-4 g-height-5 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-arrow-right s_features_icon mb-3 rounded bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-1

p.span: Order placed before 2 p.m.? Your device ships the same day. Trackable delivery within 48 hours in mainland France; free shipping on orders of €199 or more.

div.class: border o_grid_item rounded o_colored_level g-col-lg-4 g-height-5 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-money s_features_icon mb-3 rounded bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-1

p.span: You have 30 days to change your mind, no questions asked. Free returns and a full refund within 5 business days. That's our promise.

div.class: border o_grid_item rounded o_colored_level g-col-lg-4 g-height-5 col-lg-4 o_animate o_anim_fade_in o_visible

i.class: fa fa-leaf s_features_icon mb-3 rounded bg-o-color-3 text-o-color-1

p.span: Each purchase prevents an average of 70 kg of CO₂ emissions. We measure and offset the carbon footprint of our logistics operations. You’re shopping better, for real.
